nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Miri arrives Monday morning to feed the three school hens. Big brown Bess clucks hello. Orange Pepper pecks grain. But small gray Lucy is gone from the henhouse.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a gap in the fence by the rose bushes. A chicken could squeeze through easily. She feels worried but determined to find Lucy.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen listens and nods. She tells Miri Lucy may have escaped. She gives Miri a bag of sunflower seeds. Lucy loves these seeds.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks through the park calling Lucy softly. She shakes the seed bag. A girl on a bike stops and asks if she can help search.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks to the blue house next to school. An old man is sweeping his porch. He smiles and listens to her story about Lucy.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl and Miri search the park paths together. They call and listen carefully. Under an old oak tree, they spot gray feathers.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Miri pushes through tall bushes. A rabbit darts out. Only leaves and dirt here, no hen anywhere.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the old man's garden, Miri spots gray feathers under tomato plants. She hears soft clucking from behind the shed.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The old man draws a map of nearby yards. He shows Miri where other families have chickens. He offers to walk with her.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The feathers lead deeper into trees by a stream. In the ferns, Miri sees movement. She takes a breath and steps closer very slowly.'>>

choices.label: Mark the spot and search again tomorrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Near the pond, Miri sees water birds and a turtle. Then a flutter of gray and white on a rock in the middle of the water!'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Behind the shed, Lucy sits in a dust bath, warm and content. She clucks and hops toward Miri. Miri scoops her up safely.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the orchard, Miri finds Lucy pecking at fallen apples under a tree. She looks happy and healthy, just tired from her adventure.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='In the ferns, Lucy stops running. Miri makes soft clucking sounds. Lucy hops toward her and Miri catches her, warm and safe.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Cold water splashes Miri as she wades toward the rock. Lucy flaps and squawks. Miri reaches her and grabs her muddy but safe.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a woman fixing her fence nearby. She tells her about Lucy. The woman smiles, gets a long stick, and helps safely.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen hugs Miri. Lucy is safe and hungry. The old man becomes a friend. Miri learns neighbors help when you ask kindly.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The old man walks Miri back to school with Lucy. Mrs. Chen thanks him warmly. Lucy gets treats and rest in her nest.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The girl walks Miri back to school with Lucy. Mrs. Chen is relieved and grateful. The girl becomes Miri's best friend.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen laughs at wet Miri and muddy Lucy. Lucy is safe and hungry. Miri learns that small hens are tougher than they seem.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The woman is happy she could help. Mrs. Chen thanks her warmly. Lucy gets treats. Miri fixes the fence gap so it never happens.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri searches all day but cannot find Lucy anywhere. Mrs. Chen says Lucy may have gone far or found a new home. Miri feels sad but learns hens need freedom.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Days pass. Then Lucy appears by the fence, dusty but alive. She clucks to come home. Miri and Mrs. Chen repair the gap together.'>>
